The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 澤蘭 (zélán), flavor bitter, slightly warm. It governs internal bleeding of nursing women (乳婦內衄), residual disease of wind-stroke (中風余疾), great abdominal edema (大腹水腫), swelling of the body, face, and four limbs (身面四肢浮腫), water in the joints (骨節中水), and metal wounds (金瘡)...
